y-m-51-03.title: Huwandu hwemhinduro hunochinja sei painokwira k?
y-m-51-03.topic: Kusangana kwegraph ye quadratic function ine absolute value nemutsetse y=k
y-m-51-03.goal: Fungidzira nekushandura graph (kuipeta kumusoro) kuti huwandu hwe real roots ye |f(x)|=k hunoenderana ne range ye k, tarisa kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva, uye usarudze iwe pachako k dzinoenderana nemamiriro.
y-m-51-03.material: f(x)=x²-2x-3=(x+1)(x-3) ne g(x)=|f(x)|. Tinowana kuti equation g(x)=k, ndiko kuti, |f(x)|=k, ine real roots dzakasiyana dzingani zvichienderana nemutengo we k. (|f(x)| inoverengwa 'absolute value ye f ye x'.) Tisingadhiri graph zvakananga, tinovaka kutonga nekutarisa ruzivo rumwe panguva.
y-m-51-03.thinking.1: Kuchengeta kana kugadzirisa kutonga neruzivo rutsva
y-m-51-03.thinking.2: Kutsanangura kuti sei huwandu hunochinja pamitengo yemuganhu
y-m-51-03.prereq.1: Vertex ne x-intercepts ye quadratic function, nehuwandu hwe real roots ye quadratic equation
y-m-51-03.prereq.2: Chokwadi chekuti graph ye y=|f(x)| i graph apo chikamu chine f(x)<0 chakapetwa kumusoro kuyambuka x-axis
y-m-51-03.s.s1.prompt: Data rinoratidzwa danho nedanho. Nguva imwe neimwe, fungidzira huwandu hwemhinduro, uye mushure mekuona ruzivo rutsva, tarisa pfungwa dzako.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tsanangura graph ye y=|f(x)| mumashoko: yakapetwa kupi, uye poinzi yepamusoro yechikamu chakapetwa iri kupi?
y-m-51-03.s.s1.hint.1: Painokwidzwa mutsetse y=k kubva pasi, verenga kuti pamakukwirira mangani huwandu hwemapoinzi anosangana negraph hunochinja.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.0.info: y=f(x) i parabola inovhurika kumusoro, inosangana ne x-axis pa x=-1 ne x=3, uye vertex yayo i (1, -4). Graph ye y=|f(x)| i curve pa interval apo f(x) i negative (-1<x<3) yakapetwa kumusoro kuyambuka x-axis.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.0.after: f(x)=1 i x²-2x-4=0, ine real roots mbiri dzakasiyana, uye f(x)=-1 i x²-2x-2=0, ine real roots mbiri dzakasiyana, saka pane 4 dzose. Graph yakapetwa ine chimiro che W, saka y=1 inosangana nayo munzvimbo ina.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ungangodaro wakangofunga f(x)=1 chete. Verengawo mapoinzi apo chikamu chakapetwa chinosangana ne y=1.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakaverenga mhinduro dze f(x)=1 ne f(x)=-1 zvose.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Pane kukwirira kwakasiyana apo pane 3. Tarisa kana kukwirira uko i 1 yazvino.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ungangodaro wakatarisa vertex imwe chete. Verenga mapoinzi ese apo y=1 inosangana negraph.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Chikamu chakapetwa i parabola inovhurika kumusoro-pasi ine vertex (1, 4). Funga kukwidza mutsetse y=k kubva pasi, kubva ku k=1 kusvika ku k=3.9.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kunyange kana k yakwidzwa kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 3.9, huwandu hwemhinduro hunoramba pa 4 here?
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Pa k=3.9 zvakare, f(x)=3.9 ne f(x)=-3.9 imwe neimwe ine real roots mbiri dzakasiyana, saka pane 4. Usati wasvika pakukwirira kwe vertex 4, zvakarurama kuchengeta kutonga kwako kwekutanga sezvakaita.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Painoswedera ku 3.9, mhinduro dzinodzikira imwe imwe uye dzinova 3
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Huwandu hwemhinduro hunova 3 kana mutsetse unongobata kukwirira kwe vertex chaizvo. 3.9 haisati i kukwirira uko.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kana ukaikwidza zvakanyanya, mhinduro dzinodzikira uye dzinopera dziri 2
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Yakafunga kuti kukwidza kunoita kuti mhinduro dzidzikire pakarepo. Verenga zvakare kuti mapoinzi mangani anosangana nechimiro che W kana kukwirira kuri pasi pe 4.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Inoramba. Kusvikira yasvika pakukwirira kwe vertex 4, ichiri 4
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Yakachengeta kutonga kwekutanga, ichikutarisa neruzivo rutsva (kukwirira kwe vertex 4).
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Painonyanya kukwidza, ndipo painonyanya kusangana mapoinzi, ichiva 5 kana kupfuura
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Funga nezvemapoinzi mazhinji zvikuru apo curve nemutsetse zvinogona kusangana pakukwirira kumwechete mugraph iyi.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.2.info: |f(x)|=k (k≥0) i imwechete ne f(x)=k kana f(x)=-k. Discriminant ye x²-2x-3=k i 16+4k, uye discriminant ye x²-2x-3=-k i 16-4k. Uchishandisa ma discriminants aya, wana kuti pane real roots dzingani pa k=0, k=4, k=5. (|f(x)| i 0 kana kupfuura, saka kana k<0 hapana mhinduro.)
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Pfupiso ipi yakakodzera zvikuru yehuwandu hwemhinduro zvichienderana nemutengo we k?
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Huwandu hunochinja zvakaparadzana pamitengo yemuganhu k=0 ne k=4, uye pakati napo nekunze kwayo hunoramba huri 4 ne 2 zvichiteerana. Fungidziro yekutanga (4 kune k=1) yakawedzerwa kuna 0<k<4 yose.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakasiya kuti pa k=4 vertex yakapetwa nemutsetse zvinobata papoinzi imwe.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Yakasiya kuti pa k=0 pane x-intercepts mbiri (-1, 3).
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kana k i hombe kupfuura 4, verenga zvakare kuti mapoinzi mangani anosangana pamusoro pechikamu chakapetwa kumusoro.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Yakarongawo chokwadi chekuti nhamba dzakasiyana zvakaparadzana pamiganhu k=0 ne k=4.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.reflect: Neruzivo rupi wakachengeta fungidziro yawakaita pakutanga ne k=1, uye neruzivo rupi wakasvika pakuigadzirisa ne interval?
y-m-51-03.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira k 3 dzakasiyana apo |f(x)|=k ine real roots dzakasiyana 4 chaizvo. (k i real number)
y-m-51-03.s.s2.hint.0: Wana interval ine 4 pakati penhamba dzemu interval dzawakapfupisa mudanho rekare.
y-m-51-03.s.s2.hint.1: Siya mitengo yemuganhu miviri pama candidates uye usarudze mutengo uri pakati pavo.

y-m-51-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Kune k iyi, huwandu hwe real roots hahusi 4. Enzanisa nemakukwirira 0 ne 4.
y-m-51-03.s.s2.explain: Kana 0<k<4, f(x)=k ne f(x)=-k imwe neimwe ine real roots mbiri dzakasiyana, saka 4 dzose. k chero ipi murange iyi i mhinduro.
y-m-51-03.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangura, uchibatanidza nechimiro chegraph, kuti sei huwandu hwemhinduro pa k=4 hwakasiyana nema interval ari pamberi nemushure mayo, uye unyorewo nhamba dze 0<k<4 ne k>4.
y-m-51-03.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kuti poinzi yepamusoro yechikamu chakapetwa kumusoro iri kupi, wobva waverenga mapoinzi ekusangana zvakaparadzana kana mutsetse y=k unopfuura poinzi iyoyo, uri pasi payo, uye uri pamusoro payo.
y-m-51-03.s.s3.hint.1: Tsanangura mumashoko kuti poinzi yepamusoro yechikamu chakapetwa nemutsetse zvinosangana sei.
y-m-51-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Zvinosanganisira here kuti pa k=4 mutsetse unobata vertex yechikamu chakapetwa?
y-m-51-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora nhamba dze 0<k<4 ne k>4 zvakarurama here?

y-m-51-03.s.s3.model.1: y=|f(x)| i chimiro che W uye kukwirira kwepamusoro pepakati i 4. Kana mutsetse uchibata chaizvo pamusoro, unosangana papoinzi imwe ipapo, saka 3 dzose; pasi paizvozvo i 4, uye pamusoro unosangana nemapoinzi maviri ekunze chete, saka 2.

y-m-51-01.title: Kana kukosha pamagumo e interval kwakasiyana, inverse function iripo here?
y-m-51-01.topic: Quadratic function ine domain yakadzorwa uye kuvapo kwe inverse function
y-m-51-01.goal: Ratidza nemuenzaniso unopikisa kuti nei chiyero chekuti 'kana makosha e function pamagumo ose maviri e interval akasiyana, ndiyo one-to-one correspondence' hachikwani, uye ugadzire ma intervals akawanda apo inverse function iripo.
y-m-51-01.material: Rega domain ye function f(x)=x²-4x+3 ive interval a≤x≤b (a<b), uye codomain ive makosha ose anotorwa ne f paninterval iyoyo (range). Kuti inverse function ye f ivepo, f inofanira kuva one-to-one correspondence paninterval iyi. Sua akati, "Kana makosha e function pamagumo ose maviri e interval akasiyana (f(a)≠f(b)), saka f ndiyo one-to-one correspondence paninterval iyoyo." (Notation: f(x) inoverengwa 'f of x', uye x² inoverengwa 'x squared'.)
y-m-51-01.thinking.0: Ongorora kana chiyero ichi ndiyo sufficient kana necessary condition
y-m-51-01.thinking.2: Gadzira ma intervals akawanda pasi pemuganhu
y-m-51-01.prereq.0: 'H2' mubasa iri inongova label yekuoma mukugoverwa uku kwekugadzira uye haireve kuti curriculum inogovera zvirimo izvi pagiredhi rakati. Fungidzira kuti mudzidzi akatodzidza zvinodiwa pakutanga zvinotevera.
y-m-51-01.prereq.1: Graph ne axis ye quadratic function y=ax²+bx+c (nhanho ye 3rd-year middle school)
y-m-51-01.prereq.2: Functions, one-to-one correspondence, nemamiriro ekuvapo kwe inverse function (nhanho ye Common Math)
y-m-51-01.s.s1.prompt: Shandisa chiyero chaSua kune interval 0≤x≤3. Kutonga kwakakodzera zvakanyanya ndekupi?
y-m-51-01.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga f(0), f(1), f(2), f(3) nenhevedzano mukati me interval 0≤x≤3 uye uzvinyore mutafura.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.hint.1: Mutafura, tsvaga nzvimbo apo kukosha kwe function kumwe chete kunoonekwa kaviri.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.o.a: Makosha emagumo f(0) ne f(3) akasiyana, saka tinogona kutaura kuti f ndiyo one-to-one correspondence paninterval iyi
y-m-51-01.s.s1.r.a: Wakaenzanisa makosha emagumo chete. Hausati wawatarisa kana makosha emukati me interval akasiyanawo kubva kune mumwe.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.o.b: Makosha emagumo akasiyana, asi mukati me interval makosha anofukidzana, senge f(1)=f(3), saka hatigoni kutaura kuti ndiyo one-to-one correspondence
y-m-51-01.s.s1.r.b: Wakatarisa kwete makosha emagumo chete asi kana makosha emukati me interval anofukidzana.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.o.c: Kuti makosha emagumo akasiyana here hakuna hukama nekuva one-to-one correspondence, saka chiyero ichi hachina basa kubva pakutanga
y-m-51-01.s.s1.r.c: Kana ari one-to-one correspondence, makosha emagumo anofanira kusiyana, saka pane hukama. Dambudziko ndere kuti 'kusiyana' oga hakukwani.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.o.d: Kunyangwe domain ikadzorwa kuita interval, quadratic function haigoni kuva one-to-one correspondence paninterval ipi neipi
y-m-51-01.s.s1.r.d: Funga nezvenyaya apo interval isingayambuki vertex. Paninterval yakadaro makosha anogona kusafukidzana.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.explain: f(0)=3 ne f(3)=0, saka makosha emagumo anosiyana, asi f(1)=0=f(3), saka kukosha kwe function kumwe chete kunoonekwa kaviri. 'Makosha emagumo akasiyana' inongova necessary condition ye one-to-one correspondence, kwete sufficient condition.
y-m-51-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira ma intervals 3 akasiyana a≤x≤b (a<b, kureba kwe interval ndi1 kana kupfuura) apo inverse function iripo. Magumo a ne b e interval anogona kuva real numbers.
y-m-51-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza interval uye utarise nemapoinzi mashoma kana f(x) ichiramba ichifamba nenzira imwe chete sezvo x ichiwedzera mukati me interval.
y-m-51-01.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa magumo maviri e interval nenzvimbo ye axis of symmetry ye graph, uye uedze ma intervals 3 kana 4 anosarudzwa.
y-m-51-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a<b uye kureba ndi1 kana kupfuura.
y-m-51-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Tinoda a<b uye kureba kwe interval b-a kunofanira kuva 1 kana kupfuura.
y-m-51-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Paninterval iyi kukosha kwe function kumwe chete hakuoneki kaviri.
y-m-51-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Interval iyi ine x mbiri dzakasiyana dzine kukosha kwe function kumwe chete. Tsvaga x1, x2 mukati me interval ne f(x1)=f(x2).
y-m-51-01.s.s2.explain: Sezvo f(x)=(x-2)²-1, f(x1)=f(x2) zvinoreva x1=x2 kana x1+x2=4. Kana interval ikayambuka x=2 (a<2<b), pane mapoinzi maviri kumativi ose maviri e2 ane sum 4 mukati me interval, saka makosha anofukidzana. Saka interval ipi neipi ine a≥2 kana b≤2 inogona kuva mhinduro (semuenzaniso, [2,5], [-1,2], [3,4.5]).
y-m-51-01.s.s3.prompt: Pindura Sua. Tsanangura nemuenzaniso wenhamba kuti nei chiyero chaSua oga chisingakwani, uye unyore mumutsara mumwe kuti interval inofanira kuva nechimiro chipi kuti inverse function ivepo.
y-m-51-01.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza interval inopfuura chiyero chaSua asi ine makosha anofukidzana, uye ugadzire tafura yemakosha ayo e function.
y-m-51-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mu interval yawakapa, zvakajeka here kuti makosha emagumo akasiyana asi kukosha kwe function kumwe chete kunoonekwa kaviri?
y-m-51-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti interval inofanira kuva panzvimbo ipi (hukama hwayo ne axis)?
y-m-51-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakasiyanisa here kuti kuva nemakosha emagumo akasiyana kunodiwa asi hakukwani?
y-m-51-01.s.s3.model.0: Pa interval 0≤x≤3, f(0)=3 ne f(3)=0, saka makosha emagumo anosiyana, asi f(1)=f(3)=0, saka kukosha kumwe chete kunoonekwa kaviri. Saka haisi one-to-one correspondence. Interval inofanira kuva padivi rimwe chete re vertex x=2.
y-m-51-01.s.s3.model.1: Tarisa [1,4]: f(1)=0 ne f(4)=3, saka makosha emagumo anosiyana, asi f(1)=f(3), saka makosha anofukidzana. Graph yakaenzana kuruboshwe nekurudyi pa x=2 seaxis yayo, saka interval haifaniri kuyambuka axis.

y-m-51-07.title: Mapoinzi ekusangana neinverse function anogara ari pa y=x here?
y-m-51-07.topic: Mapoinzi ekusangana kwegirafu yefunction negirafu yeinverse function yayo
y-m-51-07.goal: Usagutsikane nechirevo che 'mapoinzi ekusangana kwe f ne f⁻¹ anogara ari pa y=x' nehumbowo hwefunction imwe chete; gadzira counterexample nefunction inodzika uye utsanangurire shamwari kuti inosiyana sei nefunction inokwira.
y-m-51-07.material: Minjae akati, "Mapoinzi umo y=f(x) neinverse function yayo y=f⁻¹(x) vanosangana anogara ari pamutsetse y=x. Nokuti magirafu maviri akaenzana pa y=x." Sehumbowo, akagadzirisa f(x)=x³ (chiyero inhamba dzose chaiyo) ndokuratidza kuti mapoinzi ekusangana (-1,-1), (0,0), (1,1) ose ari pa y=x. (f⁻¹ inoverengwa 'f inverse'.)
y-m-51-07.prereq.1: Zvinoreva inverse function nehukama pakati pemagirafu e f ne f⁻¹
y-m-51-07.prereq.2: Michimiro yegirafu yemapower functions x³ ne -x³
y-m-51-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kuongorora kunokodzera zvikuru kwehumbowo hwaMinjae.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ongorora kana f(x)=x³ ichikwira kana kudzika, uye uyeuke muenzaniso mumwe werudzi rwakasiyana (function inodzika).
y-m-51-07.s.s1.hint.1: Kuti poinzi yekusangana (a,b) ive pazvose f ne f⁻¹, zvose (a,b) ne (b,a) zvinofanira kuva pa f. Nyora zvinoreva izvi semutaurire.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.o.a: Akaongorora function imwe chete, saka anofanira kuedzawo nefunction isingakwiri
y-m-51-07.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga poinzi yekuti usati wawedzera mugumisiro wefunction imwe kumafunction ose, unofanira kuedza dzimwe marudzi.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.o.b: Mapoinzi ekusangana matatu akabuda, saka tinogona kutora sekuti tiri kuongorora nyaya dzakakwana
y-m-51-07.s.s1.r.b: Mapoinzi akawanda achibuda kufunction imwe chete kuongorora kwefunction imwe. Kana zvakafanana kumafunction mamwe nyaya yakasiyana.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.o.c: Magirafu akaenzana pa y=x anofanira kuva nemapoinzi ekusangana pa y=x, saka humbowo hwatopera
y-m-51-07.s.s1.r.c: Ongorora kana pasina nyaya umo magirafu maviri akaenzana anosangana kunze kwe y=x. Kunyange kana akaenzana, mapoinzi maviri anotarisana anogona kuva mapoinzi ekusangana ose maviri.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.o.d: Cubic function haina inverse function, saka humbowo uhu hazvigoni kushandiswa pakutanga
y-m-51-07.s.s1.r.d: f(x)=x³ ione-to-one correspondence panhamba dzose chaiyo, saka ine inverse function. Kuti humbowo hunogona kushandiswa here nekuti hwakakwana here zvinhu zvakasiyana.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.explain: f(x)=x³ ifunction inokwira. Kumafunction anokwira mapoinzi ekusangana ari pa y=x, asi kumafunction anodzika angasava zvakadaro. Kuongorora function imwe chete hakuvimbisi chirevo chose.
y-m-51-07.s.s2.prompt: Kune f(x)=-x³ (chiyero inhamba dzose chaiyo, one-to-one correspondence), wana mapoinzi (a, b) ari pazvose girafu ye f negirafu ye f⁻¹ asi asiri pa y=x. Gadzira mapoinzi 2 akasiyana.
y-m-51-07.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora wega mutaurire wekuti (a, b) iri pa f nemutaurire wekuti iri pa f⁻¹ (mutaurire une a ne b dzakachinjwa).
y-m-51-07.s.s2.hint.1: Isa nhamba diki dzemaintegers sa -1, 0, 1 mu a kuwana b uye uongorore kana mutaurire wechipiri uchishanda.
y-m-51-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Poinzi (b,a) iri pa f futi, saka (a,b) iri pa f⁻¹ futi.
y-m-51-07.s.s2.fail.c2: (b,a) haisi pa f, saka (a,b) haisi pa f⁻¹.
y-m-51-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Poinzi iyi iri pa y=x. Haisi counterexample.
y-m-51-07.s.s2.explain: Kana (a,b) iri pa f, saka b=-a³, uye kana iri pa f⁻¹, saka (b,a) iri pa f, saka a=-b³. Kubva mumitaurire miviri, a⁹=a, saka a=0, 1, -1, uye dzega dzisiri pa y=x mapoinzi maviri (1,-1) ne (-1,1).
y-m-51-07.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mhinduro yekutumira kuna Minjae. Ratidza zvakananga function umo chirevo chaMinjae chinoputsika nemapoinzi ayo ekusangana, uye wedzera kuti chirevo chakarurama kumafunction erudzi rupi.

y-m-51-10.title: Ongorora kushanda kwakaverenga zviratidzo zvemacoefficients kubva patsananguro yegirafu
y-m-51-10.topic: Kuverenga zviratidzo zvemacoefficients kubva pachimiro chegirafu yequadratic function
y-m-51-10.goal: Wana kukanganisa mukuverenga inequality mukushanda kunoverenga zviratidzo za a, b, c kubva pachimiro chegirafu, wana nyaya umo ruzivo rwakashaya, uye wobva wagadzira wega mafunction equadratic anokodzera mamiriro.
y-m-51-10.material: Iyi tsananguro nemashoko yegirafu yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c. Girafu iyi inovhura kudzika (convex kumusoro), vertex yayo iri kumusoro kurudyi kwe y-axis (quadrant yekutanga), inosangana ne y-axis pachikamu chakanaka (pamusoro peorigin), uye inosangana ne x-axis pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana. Hyunwoo akaverenga zviratidzo za a, b, c, nediscriminant kubva patsananguro iyi sezvakaratidzwa pazasi. (ax² inoverengwa 'a x squared', uye -b/(2a) inoverengwa 'minus b over 2a'.)
y-m-51-10.thinking.2: Gadzira zvirevo zvakati wandei pasi pomuganho
y-m-51-10.prereq.1: Chimiro chegirafu yebasa quadratic y=ax²+bx+c neaxis yayo x=-b/(2a)
y-m-51-10.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe mumushandiro waHyunwoo une hwaro hwakanganisa.
y-m-51-10.s.s1.hint.0: Pamutsetse wega wega, yedza mhedziso yawo nokugadzira basa quadratic rimwe rinosangana netsananguro iwe pachako uye uriienzanise nekukosha kwechirevo icho.
y-m-51-10.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzira basa quadratic rimwe rinosangana netsananguro, uye uenzanise padivi pedzimwe zviratidzo za a, b, c muchirevo charo nemhedziso yomutsetse wega wega.

y-m-51-10.s.s1.line.2: Axis x=-b/(2a) iri kurudyi kweaxis ye y, saka -b/(2a)>0, uye sezvo a<0, b<0.
y-m-51-10.s.s1.line.3: Inosangana neaxis ye x pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana, saka b²-4ac>0.
y-m-51-10.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 wakanganisa. Mu -b/(2a)>0, 2a ine negative, saka kuwanza mativi ose na 2a kunopesana chiratidzo chokusaenzana, kuchipa -b<0, ndiko kuti, b>0. (Kana a<0 uye axis iri kurudyi, b iri pamusoro.) Mitsetse 1, 2, ne 4 yakarurama.
y-m-51-10.s.s2.prompt: Kana tichiziva chete ruzivo rwokuti girafu yakatsvedzera kumusoro (a<0) uye inosangana neaxis ye y panzvimbo iri pamusoro (c>0), chiratidzo che b chii?

y-m-51-10.s.s2.r.a: Wakagumisa kuti b iri pamusoro kubva pa a<0 ne c>0 oga. Tarisa kana unogona kugadzira muenzaniso umo b iri negative.

y-m-51-10.s.s2.r.b: Wakagumisa kuti b iri negative kubva pa a<0 ne c>0 oga. Tarisa kana unogona kugadzira muenzaniso umo b iri pamusoro.
